## Current position

Associate Professor of Kinesiology, INEFC Lleida (Universitat de Lleida), tenured in 2026
and affiliated with the centre since 2016. Head of Research Support and Knowledge Transfer
since 2022, and member of the centre's Research Board.

I currently supervise four doctoral candidates.

## Education

| Year | Qualification and institution |
|---|---|
| 2020 | PhD in Physical Activity and Sport, Universitat de Lleida — Excellent, international mention |
| 2018 | Postgraduate specialist in university teaching, UdL |
| 2015 | MSc in Physical Activity and Health, Universitat de Barcelona |
| 2015 | Postgraduate certificate in exercise prescription for health, UdL |
| 2014 | BSc in Physical Activity and Sport Sciences, UdL |

**Doctoral thesis**: *Troponin, exercise and growth: exercise-induced release of cardiac
troponin in healthy, trained, prepubertal and pubertal males*. Supervisors: Francisco Corbi
Soler and Joaquín Reverter Masià.

## Research

I lead **EXCURSE** — *Muscle Excursion Range in Strength Training: Implications for
Performance and Injury Prevention* (INEFC, 2025–2028), co-led with Xavier Peirau Terès, and
have taken part in funded projects on physical activity on prescription, school-based health
assessment and injury prevention.

I belong to the Human Movement Research Group at INEFC/UdL and, since 2023, to the Clinical
Neurosciences group at IRBLleida, where I am responsible for statistical analysis.

## Recognition

Sport Award 2025 (ESCA project) and Sport Award 2022 (COR-School project), Generalitat de
Catalunya. Research accreditation and regional research assessment period, AQU Catalunya.
